subject: Next steps: Marketplace vendor intake & PO cadence (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <procurements@cloudbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace onboarding <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -0000
Subject: Vendor intake: initial PO details + onboarding forms

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. CloudBridge is keen to get listed on the AWS Marketplace (and evaluate Azure/GCP later this quarter). To keep procurement moving with our finance team, can you share Redwood’s preferred PO workflow + typical lead times for activation?

Quick asks from our side: 
- A simple PO template CloudBridge can raise against (we prefer a PDF to attach to our system)
- Expected timeline for marketplace-ready listing after DocuSign/MSA is returned
- Any required billing contact or tax forms for vendor activation

We have a target procurement window of 2–3 weeks if paperwork is straightforward. I’ve attached CloudBridge’s internal PO template for reference (file: CloudBridge_PO_Template.pdf).

If useful, our finance lead (finance@cloudbridge.com) can jump on a 20m sync.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
Head of Procurement, CloudBridge
procurements@cloudbridge.com

--- attachment: CloudBridge_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 98KB) ---

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <procurements@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: initial PO details + onboarding forms

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear list. Summary below and next steps so you have a single action checklist.

What we need from CloudBridge: 
- Completed PO (we can accept your PDF template or our — either works)
- Signed MSA (if you prefer, we can pre-fill and send via DocuSign)
- W-9 / tax form (for US entities) or equivalent for non-US tax IDs

What Redwood will do: 
- Send a pre-filled DocuSign copy of the MSA + SOW template by EOD today
- Create a vendor record and open the marketplace activation ticket once the signed MSA and PO are received
- Provision a Marketplace test listing (internal only) within 3 business days after onboarding ticket is accepted

Timeline (best-effort): 
1) Day 0: DocuSign sent (MSA + SOW pre-filled)
2) Day 1–3: Customer signs; CloudBridge returns PO to finance@redwood.ai
3) Day 3–7: Vendor activation + marketplace listing QA (AWS onboarding frequently takes up to 5 business days after vendor activation)

Attachments I’ll send after this thread: Redwood-Marketplace-Checklist-kw-090427.xlsx (checklist + required fields).

Next step: Aisha, please confirm whether you’ll return your PO or prefer us to issue our standard PO template. If you want a 20-minute call this week, I’ll loop Vanessa (she handles marketplace ops) and Ben from finance for PO reception.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0178

Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 15:21:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: initial PO details + onboarding forms

Thanks Kimberly — that timeline looks good. We will sign the MSA and return our PO (using our attached template).

Two quick clarifications: 
1) PO line items — can Redwood accept a single-line PO referencing the SKU and monthly commit, or do you require per-SKU breakdowns?
2) Billing cadence — monthly in arrears vs net-30 on invoice? CloudBridge prefers monthly net-30.

I’ll aim to return the signed MSA + PO by Thursday. If there’s any DocuSign link, please send it over.

Best,
Aisha
--- attachment: CloudBridge_PO_Template.pdf (showing example lines) ---

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <procurements@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: initial PO details + onboarding forms

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can accept a single-line PO referencing the agreed SKU(s) provided the PO includes: 
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- PO amount and currency
- PO date and PO number
- Billing contact: finance@redwood.ai

Billing terms: Redwood issues invoices monthly in arrears, net-30. If CloudBridge requires net-45 or modified payment terms, please flag and we can review with Revenue Ops (there may be an approval cycle).

I’ve attached our marketplace intake checklist for reference; it has the minimum fields our vendor intake team requires. Once we have the signed MSA + PO, I’ll open the activation ticket and loop AWS Marketplace for listing acceptance.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
ben@redwood.ai
--- attachment: Redwood-Marketplace-Checklist-kw-090427.xlsx ---

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 18:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: initial PO details + onboarding forms

Hi Aisha —

Great — once you send back the signed MSA and your PO we’ll: 
- Create the vendor record and share vendor ID
- Submit the AWS Marketplace vendor onboarding packet (we often get a confirmation within 48–72 hours)
- Provide a temporary test listing link for CloudBridge to validate the product page and pricing

Operational notes: 
- Please include the Tax ID on the PO PDF (redacts OK for first pass, but finance needs it for final activation)
- If you want to list on Azure/GCP simultaneously, note there are additional enrollment steps; we recommend launching on AWS first and then parallelizing others after acceptance

I’ll prepare the activation ticket as soon as I have the signed docs. Looking forward to working with CloudBridge.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
